# Draft:Pop Culture (EP)

----
Pop Culture is the debut EP by the American hardcore punk band Knocked Loose, released on June 13, 2014, through Little Heart Records. The five-track release helped establish the band's aggressive sound and gained them recognition within the hardcore and metalcore scenes.
Background and themes
Pop Culture was Knocked Loose's first official release, showcasing their raw, unfiltered approach to hardcore music. The EP features breakdown-heavy compositions, emotionally charged lyrics, and a mix of metallic hardcore influences. The opening track, "The Gospel," became one of the band's early anthems, setting the tone for their future releases.
